sloka: ततश्शापभयाद्भीत ऋश्यमूकं महागिरिम् ।प्रवेष्टुं नेच्छति हरिर्द्रष्टुं वापि नरेश्वर ॥४-११-६४॥।।
transliteration: tataśśāpabhayādbhīta ṛśyamūkaṁ mahāgirim ।praveṣṭuṁ necchati harirdraṣṭuṁ vāpi nareśvara ॥4-11-64॥।।

translations.english: 'O Lord Rama because of the fear of the curse, Vali will not enter the great Rishyamuka mountain nor will he like to see it.
